ValidationRule.description: Mega-check of phone digits, website prefix, billing country/state coherence, employee counts and rating vs tier.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Phone)), LEN(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(Phone, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '+', '')) < 7), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Website)), NOT(OR(BEGINS(LOWER(Website), 'http://'), BEGINS(LOWER(Website), 'https://'), BEGINS(LOWER(Website), 'www.')))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(BillingState)), ISBLANK(BillingCountry), LEN(BillingState) > 2), AND(NULLVALUE(NumberOfEmployees, 1) < 1, MOD(MFLOOR(NULLVALUE(AnnualRevenue, 0)), 2) = 1), AND(ISPICKVAL(Rating, 'Hot'), CASE(TEXT(Account_Tier__c), 'Gold', 0, 'Platinum', 0, 1) = 1) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Account contact/billing data failed the consistency audit.
